candidate.title: MeDIP-Seq/DIP-Seq/hMeDIP-Seq
candidate.scope: The assigned Illumina grouped schematic at antibody-enrichment architecture scope, ending at purified DNA. One methylated-DNA example is drawn, with no separate alternative branches. Interpret the targets as 5mC for MeDIP-Seq, the chosen modification (5mC/5hmC within this card) for DIP-Seq, and 5hmC for hMeDIP-Seq. Genomic DNA is both the selected substrate and the sequence carrier represented in a downstream library; antibody selection associates its genomic regions with the modification. Sequencing is named by the title/catalogue and supported by full-text DIP-Seq and hMeDIP-Seq methods, but library construction and sequencing are not additional depicted operations. This correspondence does not establish identical complete protocols, interchangeable names, or historical priority.

states.label: Methylated DNA in chromatin (depicted label; target-specific interpretation)
features: DNA is wrapped around grey nucleosome-like bodies and carries red marks. The leftmost similar icon accompanies the assay title; it is not a second processing branch.

At this grouped schematic scope the marks mean 5mC for MeDIP-Seq, the chosen cytosine modification for DIP-Seq (5mC/5hmC within this card), and 5hmC for hMeDIP-Seq. The latter is a primary-source-supported interpretation of the generic icon, not a depicted conversion of 5mC to 5hmC.

evidence.quote: MeDIP-Seq/DIP-Seq/hMeDIP-Seq

Methylated DNA immunoprecipitation sequencing (MeDIP-Seq), DNA immunoprecipitation sequencing (DIP-Seq) or Hydroxymethylated DNA immunoprecipitation sequencing (hMeDIP-Seq), is commonly used to study 5mC or 5hmC modification. Specific antibodies can be used to study cytosine modifications. If using 5mC-specific antibodies, methylated DNA is isolated from genomic DNA via immunoprecipitation. Anti-5mC antibodies are incubated with fragmented genomic DNA and precipitated, followed by DNA purification and sequencing. Deep sequencing provides greater genome coverage, representing the majority of immunoprecipitated methylated DNA.

The denatured DNA was subsequently mixed with 50 μl 10× IP buffer (1.4 M NaCl, 100 mM Na-phosphate, pH 7.0, 0.5% Triton X-100), followed by incubation with 1 μl anti-5hmC antibody described above at 4°C overnight.
evidence.rationale: Full-text evidence for denatured DNA and anti-5hmC selection. Quoted conditions are evidence, not extracted execution requirements.

states.label: Fragmented, denatured genomic DNA
features: Several shorter DNA lines replace the long extracted DNA, and only a subset carry red marks. The stacked caption supplies both fractionation and denaturation; no intermediate or separately collected fractions are drawn.
The exposed DNA strands are the antibody-selection substrate. No modification conversion is depicted.

Adapter status is unspecified, not asserted to be adapter-free. Shen uses sonicated, adaptor-ligated genomic DNA; Jin also ligates adapters before denaturation/capture. These unshown interfaces fit the generic fragment icon.

evidence.locator: Arrow to short DNA lines, a subset with red marks, above stacked Fractionate and Denature captions

evidence.quote: The antisera for 5fC and 5caC were previously described (Inoue et al., 2011). For each DIP experiment, 10 µg of sonicated, adaptor ligated genomic DNA from control or Tdg knockdown mouse ESCs was used as input, and 5 µl of 5mC antibody (Eurogentec, BI-MECY-0500), 5 µL of 5hmC antibody (Active Motif, 39791), 1 µl of 5fC antiserum or 0.3 µl of 5caC antiserum was used to immunoprecipitate modified DNA as previously described (Wu et al., 2011a). Immunoprecipitated DNA was further amplified for high-throughput sequencing.
evidence.rationale: Full-text evidence for modification-specific capture of sonicated, adaptor-ligated genomic DNA, followed by amplification for sequencing. Only the 5mC/5hmC cases clarify this card; the paper's other targets do not expand the diagram scope.

states.label: Purified, immunoprecipitation-enriched DNA
features: The rightmost DNA product is drawn as three grey fragment lines without antibody icons. Red marks are omitted here, but no chemical demethylation is labeled; the selected DNA remains the enriched material represented by the product.

This is the depicted output interface to downstream library completion and sequencing. DNA inserts represent genomic fragments retained by antibody selection. Sequence identifies genomic origin; enrichment associates those regions with the chosen modification.

For the methylated example the catalogue reports approximately 150 bp resolution, specificity/selectivity limitations and bias toward hypermethylated regions. This readout does not directly identify every modified nucleotide or an absolute methylation fraction. The anti-5mC specificity claim does not describe hMeDIP-Seq exclusion of 5hmC.

operations.label: Immunoprecipitate
operations.description: Select target-bearing fragments from fragmented, denatured DNA by association with the target-directed antibody. The product is antibody-associated, modification-enriched DNA; faded unselected fragments are not a retained output.
operations.mechanism: Affinity recognition of modified DNA: anti-5mC for the methylated example, anti-5hmC for hMeDIP-Seq, and the selected modification-specific antibody for DIP-Seq. This selects DNA rather than a histone protein.
operations.information_effect: Capture associates whole genomic fragments with the chosen chemical target; it does not locate the precise modified cytosine or guarantee exclusive target recovery.

Retain the source label as a diagram observation; do not insert a 5mC-to-5hmC conversion.

evidence.quote: MeDIP-Seq/DIP-Seq/hMeDIP-Seq

Methylated DNA immunoprecipitation sequencing (MeDIP-Seq), DNA immunoprecipitation sequencing (DIP-Seq) or Hydroxymethylated DNA immunoprecipitation sequencing (hMeDIP-Seq), is commonly used to study 5mC or 5hmC modification. Specific antibodies can be used to study cytosine modifications. If using 5mC-specific antibodies, methylated DNA is isolated from genomic DNA via immunoprecipitation. Anti-5mC antibodies are incubated with fragmented genomic DNA and precipitated, followed by DNA purification and sequencing. Deep sequencing provides greater genome coverage, representing the majority of immunoprecipitated methylated DNA.

The denatured DNA was subsequently mixed with 50 μl 10× IP buffer (1.4 M NaCl, 100 mM Na-phosphate, pH 7.0, 0.5% Triton X-100), followed by incubation with 1 μl anti-5hmC antibody described above at 4°C overnight.
evidence.rationale: Full-text evidence for denatured DNA and anti-5hmC selection. Quoted conditions are evidence, not extracted execution requirements.

checks.rationale: Independent inspection supports the complete candidate at its declared grouped schematic scope. The image contains one continuous DNA route represented by five states, four local operations and eight material-input/output edges; every depicted transformation is retained. The left title icon is not an additional branch, and faded unselected fragments have no retained outgoing route. The card explicitly targets MeDIP-Seq, DIP-Seq and hMeDIP-Seq. Target-specific interpretation is distinguished from the methylated example actually drawn. DNA remains the substrate and downstream sequence carrier, while antibody enrichment supplies the modification association. No adapter chemistry, end groups, compartment, pooling, base conversion, or library-building operations are invented. The hMeDIP correction, all local interfaces and method assignments, and all eight paper associations were checked separately below. Limited Weber/related-paper abstracts are not treated as full-text protocol verification, and no historical-priority or complete-protocol equivalence claim is made.
